findings.location: Paragraph: "As one woman wrote..." (source.html third full paragraph)
findings.source_quote: ...we were shocked to suddenly hear that mothering only takes a third-grade education and a fulltime mother is unnecessary.
findings.suggested_fix: Use a more natural Dutch rendering of "third-grade education" (meaning: very little formal education) to improve clarity. For example: replace "derdeklasopleiding" with "opgeleidingsniveau van groep drie" or "slechts het niveau van de basisschool" while preserving the intended meaning.
findings.translation_quote: …dat moeder-zijn maar een derdeklasopleiding vereist en een fulltime moeder niet nodig is.
